patterns: Franchise first-looks dominate: Stranger Things prequel teaser (2.16M), Clayface practical suit (311k), ST UFO still (269k), Hunger Games poster (130k).
Industry money news still clears seven figures: NYT ↔ Letterboxd talks hit 1.20M on DiscussingFilm.
Greenlights with star names travel: animated John Wick + Keanu (656k), Midnight Sun 2-season Netflix order (238k), FEED with Rosamund Pike (316k).
Trailer drops with hard dates win: Cliff Booth IMAX Nov 25 (371k), Ray Gunn Dec 18 Netflix (280k), Air Bud Jan 2027 (194k).
Premiere / fashion stills bank soft virality: MBJ + Yerin Ha Yurman (370k), Mckenna Grace Hunger Games Madrid (170k).
Classic-film trivia and ‘which film introduced you to X’ polls keep ATRightMovies in the 10–40k band all day.
narrative_synthesis: Franchise first-looks ran the board: the Stranger Things prequel teaser hit 2,157,811 views on DiscussingFilm (95 originals ≥5k). Letterboxd/NYT talks (1.20M), Perfect Girl first look (934k), and animated John Wick greenlight (656k) filled the next tier. @RealEmirHan had no originals ≥5k in the window.
